title: Add an item to the cart and complete checkout
description: A shopper can add a product to the cart, choose a shipping address, and finish checkout successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Select a shipping address
Complete the checkout process
Verify an order confirmation is visible
Verify checkout success messaging is displayed

title: Register a new account and verify the OTP
description: A new shopper can complete registration, enter the 6-digit verification code, and land in an authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Fill in the name field with a new valid name
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with a new valid email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Fill in the OTP field with a valid 6-digit code
Submit the OTP form
Verify the account is verified and the user is logged in

title: Access the admin area after signing in
description: An admin user can sign in and reach the protected admin experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the admin area
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Admin can log in and reach the product inventory
description: This verifies that an admin can authenticate and access the product inventory view in the management panel.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Verify the product inventory list is displayed

title: Browse products and open a product detail page
description: A shopper can search or browse the catalog and open a product detail view from the results.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Search for a product using a relevant keyword
Open a product from the search results
Verify the product detail view is displayed
Verify product images and details are displayed

title: Apply a valid coupon during checkout
description: A shopper can apply a valid promo code and see the discounted order total.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Select a shipping address
Apply a valid coupon code
Verify the discounted total is displayed
Verify the coupon is applied successfully

title: Require a shipping address before checkout completion
description: A shopper cannot complete checkout until a shipping address is selected.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Complete the checkout process without selecting a shipping address
Verify a checkout validation error is visible

title: Admin can create a new product
description: This verifies that an admin can add a new product and see it appear in the inventory list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Open the product creation flow
Fill in the required product details
Submit the product form
Verify the newly created product appears in the inventory list

title: Filter products by category, subcategory, and brand
description: A shopper can narrow the catalog using supported filters and see matching products.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Select a category filter
Select a subcategory filter
Select a brand filter
Verify matching products are displayed
Verify pagination data is displayed

title: Admin can update an existing product
description: This verifies that an admin can edit a product and see the updated inventory information saved.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Open an existing product for editing
Change a product field
Save the product changes
Verify the updated product information is displayed in the inventory list

title: Update cart quantity and see totals recalculate
description: A shopper can change item quantity in the cart and see the updated totals reflected in the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Increase the item quantity
Verify the cart totals are recalculated
Verify the updated quantity is displayed

title: Admin can manage orders from the dashboard
description: This verifies that an admin can open the orders section and view the orders list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Open the orders section
Verify the orders list is displayed

title: Prevent checkout with an invalid coupon
description: A shopper sees coupon validation feedback when an invalid or expired promo code is entered.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Apply an invalid coupon code
Verify coupon validation errors are visible

title: Admin can manage coupons from the dashboard
description: This verifies that an admin can open the coupons section and view the available coupons.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Open the coupons section
Verify the coupons list is displayed

title: Reject invalid registration details
description: A shopper sees validation feedback when registration is submitted with missing or invalid details.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Submit the registration form without completing the required details
Verify registration validation errors are visible

title: Reject an incorrect OTP during verification
description: A shopper who enters the wrong 6-digit code is prevented from verifying the account.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Fill in the name field with a new valid name
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the email field with a new valid email address
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Fill in the OTP field with an incorrect 6-digit code
Submit the OTP form
Verify OTP verification errors are visible

title: Show an empty state for a search with no matches
description: A shopper sees an empty result state when a search returns no products.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Search for a product using a unique unavailable keyword
Verify an empty results message is visible

title: Block checkout when a cart item is out of stock or invalid
description: A shopper is prevented from updating the cart with an out-of-stock product or invalid quantity.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open a product from the product list
Add the product to the cart
Proceed to checkout
Update the item quantity to an invalid value
Verify a cart update validation error is visible

title: Admin is blocked from protected orders access without authorization
description: This verifies that accessing protected admin orders content without an admin session is blocked.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Open the orders section
Verify access is denied to the orders section

title: Prevent access to protected admin actions without permission
description: A non-admin user is blocked from protected admin routes and sees an access denied state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open a protected admin area
Verify an unauthorized access message is visible

title: Admin is blocked from deleting coupons without permission
description: This verifies that a restricted admin coupon action cannot be completed without proper permission.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin management entry point
Open the coupons section
Attempt to delete a coupon without permission
Verify the coupon remains available and the deletion is blocked

title: Handle an unsupported product filter value
description: A shopper is shown a clear filter error when an unsupported filter value is used.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Apply an unsupported filter value
Verify a filter validation error is visible
